shortBulletSummary: Crypto Market Downturn: Bitcoin fell below $70,000, and Ethereum under $1,900; crypto market cap lost $110B.
Spot Bitcoin ETF Outflows: Billions withdrawn from spot BTC ETFs signal weak institutional demand.
Geopolitical Tensions: US-Iran conflict escalation drives global risk-off sentiment in markets.
Macroeconomic Headwinds: Persistent inflation fears and Fed rate uncertainty pressure crypto.
Strategy BTC Sale: First Bitcoin sale by Strategy in years adds to market's "Extreme Fear."
